# Structural research after the width-seven construction

This pass constructs and fully checks a smaller further improvement,
**conditional kappa = 0.001600682403612293**, while investigating the changes
needed for a materially larger gain. That is **0.03843% above PR569**, not a
new one-percent improvement. The larger-gain experiments below are separate
from this admitted finite construction.

The work starts from PR569's numerical and attribution state at
`f1db606a1416359229f944946667338305208064`, followed by packaging-only commit
`1424da81263a5305b35e4cf74ef686c275f03f3f`, which adds seven already
manifest-bound replay logs previously excluded by Git's ignore rule. All
341 `research/larger-gain` artifacts retain their recorded hashes. PR564
remains an external pinned dependency at
`c18417b02b80594b2ca1c8c21185d28befafc935`. Upstream main was fetched again
and remains `db0e57bc7f36b5ac0fc844ad7ce1396165ee6647`. PR568 and PR567 were
fetched and examined for composition. The later PR570, fetched at
`9278e39baec4f23267336c7d212306d0c0003d08`, concerns explicit ceiling-log
tapes and supplies no new kappa theorem or constant-time indexing result.

## A concrete new construction

The new A-prefix selects different exact donor components, reducing its
69 gates to 57. PR568 contributes four further cold kernels beyond PR569's
overlapping relations. Their composition with the 32 width-seven promotions
has exactly PR569's residual-width inventory and changes its local paid
profile by `-12 H2 + 8 H3`. This permits reuse of its physical geometry after
an explicit helper permutation.

Replacing the 63 width-seven calls, while retaining nine plain four-cold
calls, gives the global profile:

```text
{1:169056, 2:40428, 3:26472, 4:13824, 5:4032,
 6:4032, 7:48, 8:576, 48:1808}
```

The native complex rate is `0.001603248695587935849402`. The separate
conservative assembly passes at kappa `0.001600682400830496`. Dimension 73,
live stock 7168, physical stock 7682 and deficit 2560 are unchanged. The
construction passes complete native and phase checks, literal hosting,
invoice and both exact arithmetic models. A fresh portable replay passed all
18 stages in 149.5 seconds and reproduced both kappa values. Its local omission controls reject
135 scalar mutations; the global checks include 16 owner mutations,
93 assembly mutations, two accepted timing changes and two rejected semantic
phase changes. See [the composition package](frontier-composition/README.md)
for the exact inputs, artifacts, dependencies and replay boundary.

No new unconditional multiplier theorem, all-size compiler proof, complete
Lean proof or worst-case O(1) indexing theorem is claimed. All inherited
interfaces and assumptions remain. No code-review workflow was run in this
pass, as requested; the checks above verify the mathematical experiments.

## What was actually tried for a larger gain

| Direction | Experiment and result |
| --- | --- |
| Global frame choices and packing | Enumerated all allowed subspace states and transitions, existing entrance enlargements and capacity patterns together: 152,742 variables. An optimizer-independent rational certificate excludes kappa `0.00160062` for the three fixed four-cold words. This leaves less than 0.035% above PR569 in that family. |
| Joint donor bases | Unlocked all 44 static kernel pivots. Fixed and raised first-frame searches covered 1,357 and 1,997 compatible classes. The improved 57-gate prefix is positive; no rank-three or rank-four dependency appeared in those classes. |
| Shared multi-cut kernels | After unlocking eight B kernels, tested 16 rank-two circuits and all 256 paired mixtures. Of these, 192 had valid exact scalar/frame realizations; none improved the tested packing-price objective over keeping the rank-one circuits. This is a bounded search, not a universal exclusion. |
| Joint kernel and gauge choices | Tested projected response dependencies on forbidden output coordinates, permitting a compatible residual to be canceled by shared gauges. Of 2,789 entrance subspaces, 2,763 admitted no suitable output/center coordinate; the remaining 26 supplied no required dependency. |
| Cheaper packet factory | Verified a 224-helper lower bound for the current packet interface, and 392 including its required second copies. These bounds fix the packet planes, nested frames and scalar primitive model. |
| Borrowing foreign outputs | Found an injective geometric assignment for 28 actual helpers. Executed a literal partial inverse and 160 exact restoration-span checks. The current donor rows cannot clear the remaining source term within the output cap. A fresh replacement helper removes the apparent saving. |

Details and replay commands are in [joint-basis](joint-basis/README.md),
[frame-optimization](frame-optimization/README.md), and
[factory](factory/README.md). The negative results have different scopes;
they must not be combined into an unrestricted impossibility claim.

## The measured larger-gain target

The 28 actual factory helpers identified by the borrowing experiment each
pay `3 H1 + H6` and occupy a width-nine residual. Their paths were checked in
all six original four-cold/width-seven words. Counterfactually removing those
paths and their corresponding demands, with **no replacement or output-path
cost**, produces the following exact fractional-packing moment prices:

| Hypothetical paths removed per call | Complex-side kappa target | Relative to PR569 |
| ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 6 | 0.001611776947926596 | +0.73181% |
| 14 | 0.001626974089806911 | +1.68159% |
| 28 | 0.001654270333518889 | +3.38753% |

These are design targets, not achieved constructions. The exact rational
packing and both moment engines verify only the stated hypothetical model.
They supply no cleanup circuit, physical owner assignment or bit-side
composition. The largest target also needs more bit-side headroom than the
currently cited PR543 supplier; PR555 is a possible separately replayable
source. See `frame-optimization/BORROW-SENSITIVITY.json` and
`borrow_sensitivity.py`.

The next substantive change would retain part of the packet computation in
foreign output coordinates as part of their final desired values. It must
jointly change packet delivery, the output basis and the center injection,
instead of restoring outputs before their unchanged current loads. The
current experiments identify the exact residual source term and frame caps
that such a construction must overcome. Nonmonotone frame traversals cannot
be charged only as scalar gates: their added recursive rank mass directly
reduces the recurrence deficit.
